input.title: Updating iOS from the N-1 store build to iOS Submission #50 resets the save to level 1
input.description:
Found by the QA regression runbook's update-path check on the ZOM-570 store candidates (Brian's run: "Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135").

**What happens**
On iPhone 13 / iOS 18.6, installing iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50) over the N-1 App Store build brings the save back at **level 1 with 500 coins**. Before the update the account was on **level 212 with 18,400 coins**. Relaunching doesn't restore it.

**Repro**
1. Install the N-1 build from the App Store.
2. Play past level 200.
3. Install TestFlight 50 (iOS Submission #50) over it.
4. Launch.

**Expected:** level, coins and unlocks carry over the update, as they do in the other update rows.

**Other update rows in the same run (all passed: level, coins and unlocks kept)**
* iPhone 13, iOS N-2 → #50
* Pixel 6 / Android 14, N-1 → Android Submission #135
* Pixel 6 / Android 14, N-2 → Android Submission #135

**Device:** iPhone 13, iOS 18.6
**Source build:** N-1 App Store build → iOS Submission #50

Per the runbook this counts as save/progression loss in an UPDATE column, so it blocks the release. It's on ZOM-570 as a blocker.

* **ZOM-559** - Samsung home-out: victory screen freezes until force-quit (latest check on #133, not re-tested on #135)

text:
QA gate on Android #135 / iOS #50: **NO-GO** from QA for Friday as things stand.

Brian's fresh-install matrix is green. But the runbook's update path fails on iOS: N-1 → #50 brings the save back at level 1 (was level 212). Runbook rule: a failure in an update column blocks the release. Filed as ZOM-581.

**14 blockers** (keys are on ZOM-570):
• ZOM-581 iOS N-1 update wipes progress
• ZOM-435 trophy path stuck again on #135, have to kill the app
• ZOM-567 Zombie Lane chests still don't land on prod. #36 is deployed, but its chest-rows data load hasn't been run on prod.
• ZOM-569 Season Pass empty screen. The fix landed at 21:36Z, after the 18:4xZ Started lines, so it's not in #135 / #50.
• ZOM-449 low-end level 3 cold-start freeze
• ZOM-578 fresh install stuck at tutorial step 3
• ZOM-483 infinite-lives time lost on relaunch
• ZOM-560 abandoned pack doesn't deliver the freezer time
• ZOM-554 tornado quit leaves the next level unplayable
• ZOM-546 endless refill drains the board
• ZOM-576 SP premium tier drops the booster bundle
• ZOM-573 Collect&Win 5th chest crash
• ZOM-559 Samsung home-out freeze (latest check on #133, not re-tested on #135)
• DES-313 level 214 can't be completed

Also: 22 known issues; 11 fixed (2 seen working, 2 not reproducible, ZOM-563 on prod, 6 fixed in the builds but not re-checked); the rest are no call. Full register is in the "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50" tab of the release gate sheet.

Correction to the fixed breakdown above: of the 11 fixed, 1 was seen working on the candidates (ZOM-564), 2 couldn't be reproduced (ZOM-517, ZOM-429), ZOM-563 is live on prod, and 7 are fixed in the builds but not re-checked. Blockers and the call are unchanged.
